text:
Ana (CSM): quick weekly check-in for OrchidLabs — noticed hit rate dropped to ~22% (was 38% two weeks ago), avg batch size down to 1.6, p95 latency up to 210ms, error rate creeping to 0.6% (some retries), and spend +12% w/w. cost per 1k tokens moved from $3.80 -> $4.20. suspect a shift toward many small, short-lived queries reducing batching effectiveness. any quick wins we can try this week?

Mike (Success Eng): thanks Ana. agree this looks like a small-request surge. do we have percent of requests <128 tokens? if that spikes, batching suffers. can we pull the token-distribution?

Devon (Platform): I pulled a quick histogram for last 72h — small requests (<128) are 62% (was ~35%). also noticed higher fanout from one tenant key: orchid-ingest-service.

Liam (Finance): rough calc: if batching efficiency drops, token-cost per 1k rises. with the numbers above the marginal spend aligns with the +12%. would like a short estimate if we adjust batching window.

Mike (Success Eng): quick experiment suggestion: bump per-route batching window from 20ms -> 35ms for orchid-ingest-service in staging and measure avg batch size + p95. tradeoff: slightly higher single-request latency for better unit cost.

Devon (Platform): current route config: `batching: {window_ms: 20, min_batch_size: 1, max_delay_ms: 100}`. I can push a canary change. command I use locally:```bash
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.example/v1/routes/orchid-ingest-service -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD' -d '{"batching":{"window_ms":35}}'
```
will do staging canary in 30m.

OpsBot: Automated alert: increased small_request_ratio for route orchid-ingest-service — small_req_ratio=0.62, baseline=0.35, triggered=2026-03-18T09:41:03Z

Ana (CSM): perfect. Mike can you own the canary and measure hit rate / avg batch size / cost delta? please post numbers here. Devon please coordinate the rollout and ensure a quick rollback path. Liam i'll need a 24h cost delta estimate after canary.

Mike (Success Eng): on it — I'll run canary in staging then prod canary at 5% traffic for 2 hours. target metrics to track: batch_size_avg, caching_hit_rate, p95_latency, error_rate, cost_per_1k_tokens. will post snapshot.

Devon (Platform): canary scheduled 10:15 PT -> 12:15 PT. rollback flag ready. will also enable short-lived telemetry tag: `orchid-batch-test-03`.

Liam (Finance): thanks — if batch_size_avg improves from 1.6 -> 2.4 we should see ~17% cost reduction on token unit economics. I'll prep a short note for the renewal risk board.

Mike (Success Eng): quick note on measurement: caching hit rate improvements likely need both batching and prefix cache tuning. if we see small uplift in hit rate (20% -> 30%) that's good. I'll also test increasing cache TTL for recurrent prompts.

Ana (CSM): action items: 1) Mike — run canary + post metrics (owner Mike). 2) Devon — deploy canary + rollback plan (owner Devon). 3) Liam — cost delta & renewal note (owner Liam). 4) Mike/Devon — update runbook with new per-route batching knobs if successful. Check-in in this thread in 3 hours.

Mike (Success Eng): noted. posting baseline before canary: hit_rate=0.22, batch_size_avg=1.6, p95=210ms, errors=0.6%, cost_per_1k=$4.20.

Devon (Platform): staging canary done. staging snapshot: hit_rate=0.31, batch_size_avg=2.1, p95=225ms (staging), errors=0.15%. pushing 5% prod canary now.

OpsBot: Deploy bot: route orchid-ingest-service batching.window_ms updated 20->35 at 2026-03-18T10:18:02Z by devon. canary=5%

Mike (Success Eng): prod 5% canary initial: hit_rate=0.29, batch_size_avg=2.05, p95=216ms, errors=0.18%, cost_per_1k_est=$3.90 (projected). Looks promising.

Ana (CSM): great — please let the canary run full 2 hrs. if stable, move to 50% then full.

Liam (Finance): preliminary projection for full rollout: cost_per_1k -> ~$3.35 (12% unit cost drop), monthly spend change expected -9% given traffic profile. I'll attach numbers to the renewal doc after final roll.

Mike (Success Eng): will post final canary results and open a short PR to update the default route profile if we decide to keep window at 35ms. also will test TTL bump for cache keys.

Devon (Platform): noted, will also add telemetry annotation and update the runbook steps for rollback.

Ana (CSM): thanks team. follow-up here in ~2.5 hours with final numbers. 

Mike (Success Eng): final canary snapshot (12:12 PT): hit_rate=0.33 overall, batch_size_avg=2.24, p95=220ms, errors=0.17%, cost_per_1k_actual=$3.82. rolling to 50% now.

Devon (Platform): 50% rollout complete. monitoring for anomalies.

Ana (CSM): excellent — tagging this as `orchid-weekly-batching-2026-03-18`. will record highlights for the account health dashboard and note the reduced renewal risk.

Mike (Success Eng): closing loop: if anything regresses, rollback to 20ms and alert #eng-runtime. otherwise we'll update default route config next week. :thumbsup:
